title: USACE Works to Re-initiate the Collier County Coastal Storm Risk Management Feasibility Study
description: Col. Brian Hallberg along with members of the Norfolk District, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers' Collier County Coastal Storm Risk Management Feasibility Study project delivery team, and Collier County representatives talk about the study and some of the challenges Collier County faces in the wake of Hurricane Ian.
